# Microbiome Abundance and Dyad Sharing Visualizations

Microbiome profiling requires visualizing relative abundances across taxonomic ranks and tracking shared strain transmission across clinical dyads. This chapter covers bubble matrices and circular dyad sharing plots.

## Bubble Matrices: `type = "bubble_matrix"`

Bubble matrices encode two data dimensions simultaneously: circle area represents mean relative abundance, while fill color represents fold change, prevalence, or statistical significance:

```{r bubble-matrix-demo, fig.width=8.0, fig.height=4.8}
library(cliomicplot)

set.seed(42)
species <- c("S. aureus", "S. epidermidis", "C. acnes",
             "M. restricta", "S. hominis", "L. crispatus")
comparisons <- c("Lesional vs HC", "Non-Lesional vs HC", "Lesional vs Non-Lesional")

da_df <- expand.grid(Species = species, Comparison = comparisons, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
da_df$log2FC <- c(3.2, -1.8, -0.4, 1.2, -2.1, -0.2,
                  0.8, -0.9, -0.1, 0.4, -1.0,  0.1,
                  2.4, -0.9, -0.3, 0.8, -1.1, -0.3)
da_df$qval <- c(1.2e-6, 4.5e-4, 0.42, 0.012, 8.1e-5, 0.65,
                0.08,   0.03,   0.85, 0.31,  0.02,   0.78,
                5.4e-5, 0.04,   0.55, 0.06,  0.03,   0.51)

p_bubble <- cliplot(
  Species ~ Comparison,
  data = da_df,
  type = type_bubble_matrix(
    size_col = "qval",
    fill_col = "log2FC",
    min_size = 2.0,
    max_size = 7.0,
    palette  = "nature"
  ),
  title = "Differential Cutaneous Bacterial Abundance Across Clinical Contrasts"
)
p_bubble
```

## Circular Dyad Sharing: `type = "sharing_heatmap"`

Circular dyad sharing maps strain transmission between paired individuals (such as mother-infant dyads or twin pairs) or between coupled anatomical compartments:

```{r sharing-demo, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4.2}
set.seed(42)
dyads <- paste0("Dyad ", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))
taxa  <- c("S. epidermidis ST2", "S. epidermidis ST5", "S. hominis ST1",
           "C. acnes IA", "C. acnes II", "M. restricta ST4")

dyad_data <- expand.grid(Taxon = taxa, Dyad = dyads, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dyad_data$Transmission <- ifelse(
  runif(nrow(dyad_data)) > 0.44, "Shared (Transmitted)", "Not shared"
)

p_share <- cliplot(
  Taxon ~ Dyad,
  data   = dyad_data,
  type   = type_sharing_heatmap(
    status_col     = "Transmission",
    shared_color   = "#E64B35",
    unshared_color = "#EDF1F7",
    legend_title   = "Dyad Status"
  ),
  preset = "nature",
  title  = "Vertical Mother-Infant Strain Transmission at 12 Months"
)
p_share
```
